title: A grumpy robot
done: You made a grumpy robot! Give it a hug. Beep boop. Better.

steps.say: Put a big blue square flat on the table. It is the robot's face.
Put a square next to it. An ear.
A square on the other side. Two ears.
A triangle on top. Its beeper.
A small triangle under the face. It is grumpy because it needs a charge.
